finding_dispositions.note: Mt 5:3, 5:6 and 5:10 keep their qualifiers everywhere; the join rests on Augustine's De serm. Dom. I.3.10/I.4.11 pairing, stated as the preacher's inference, and the note's own-connections list describes it.

Augustine now puts the complaint in a hearer's heart, tells him not to say it, admits only the literal appearance, and warns of the snare (Enarr. 33 s.2 n.14, Migne Latin); the response uses the hearer's practice as the homily's own pattern, recorded in the note.
Bernard, Augustine's scheme, Basil and Bernard n.5 are given with their reasoning in plain sentences, and one sentence states why the Collect and Postcommunion follow.
The three restatements and the 'go without ... not without' reversal are cut; the Gradual and Offertory are joined once.

summary: Revised the All Saints homily to clear HOM-001 to HOM-004 and the advisories HOM-005 and HOM-006: the Gospel's qualifiers are kept and the Gradual-Gospel join now rests on Augustine's pairing of the fear of the Lord with the poor in spirit; Augustine's hearer is reported as the locus has him, with his verdict (the snare); the closing section is carried in the preacher's voice; the 'go without' reversals and restatements are gone; the note and production review were updated, the revision timestamp refreshed, and the 4-page homily PDF rebuilt and checked (component and every preflight check pass). This dispatch contributed the iteration-1 revision of the homily's spoken body, terminal note and production-review record for run 450355254538c1ba.
